name: Burglar
summary: An infiltration expert who disarms traps cautiously and bluffs away noises made while hidden.

features.name: Careful Disarm
features.summary: Trigger a trap while disarming only when failing by 10 or more, and add double Trap Sense when avoiding a triggered trap.

features.name: Distraction
features.summary: When detected but unseen during Stealth, oppose Sense Motive with Bluff to make the noise seem innocent.
